prompt: Audit AAPL filing year 2023: separately retrieve share repurchase authorization disclosures and cash dividend disclosures. Provide original supporting excerpts for both.

subqueries.query: cash dividend declared per share disclosure

hops.rationale: The original goal is the AAPL FY2023 share repurchase authorization disclosure. Passage 000032019323000106#passage-000055 states the Board authorized up to $90 billion under a program announced May 4, 2023, with $15.9 billion utilized, and that the programs do not obligate a minimum purchase. Passage -000094 (Note 10) adds 471 million shares repurchased for $76.6 billion in 2023. Passage -000064 confirms the authorized program. Together these fully support the authorization disclosure. The cash dividend part of the audit prompt is outside this subquery's goal.

This fully answers the dividend-declared-per-share goal for the 2023 filing. Passage 000032019323000106#passage-000073 (cash flow dividends paid) is supporting context only. Passage 000032019323000106#passage-000052 and passage-000065 are general dividend and buyback language without amounts. Share repurchase authorization is not covered by the evidence, but that is outside this dividend-specific subquery and is a separate audit component. No retained passages are needed because the goal is fully supported.

Verified filing excerpts (extractive audit evidence; no derived calculations):

- As of September 30, 2023, the Company was authorized by the Board of Directors to purchase up to $90 billion of the Company’s common stock under a share repurchase program announced on May 4, 2023, of which $15.9 billion had been utilized. [AAPL-2023-10K-p000055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000055`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
- During the fourth quarter of 2023, the Company also utilized the final $4.6 billion under its previous repurchase program, which was most recently authorized in April 2022. [AAPL-2023-10K-p000055](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000055`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
- During 2023, the Company repurchased 471 million shares of its common stock for $ 76.6 billion, excluding excise tax due under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. [AAPL-2023-10K-p000094](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000094`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
- As of September 30, 2023, the Company’s quarterly cash dividend was $0.24 per share. [AAPL-2023-10K-p000064](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000064`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
- The Company intends to increase its dividend on an annual basis, subject to declaration by the Board of Directors. [AAPL-2023-10K-p000065](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000065`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
- Dividends and dividend equivalents declared per share or RSU $ 0.94 $ 0.90 $ 0.85 [AAPL-2023-10K-p000071](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/aapl-20230930.htm) (chunk: `000032019323000106#passage-000071`; accession: `0000320193-23-000106`).
